info.title: Muni API
info.description: Sprint retrospectives that start before the meeting.

post.summary: Sign out of this device.
Sign out everywhere else.

get.summary: Who am I, and which workspaces can I see.

patch.summary: Change the display name shown on the speaking card and attendance list.

post.summary: Request a one-time sign-in code by email.

get.summary: Active sessions for this account.

post.summary: Exchange a code for a session. Consumes the code; bounded attempts.
Seed (or reset) the demo workspace for the calling account. Development only.

get.summary: Development inbox: messages captured by the in-memory mail transport. Never available with SMTP.
Preview an invitation. Safe without a session: reveals only a masked address.

post.summary: Accept an invitation with a session whose verified email matches. Single use.

get.summary: Where should a new thought go? Powers the bookmarkable /capture route.
A sprint as seen by the caller. Never includes per-person contribution status.

patch.summary: Update sprint setup. Privacy/AI choices lock once collection starts.

get.summary: AI preparation status, jobs and proposals for this sprint.

post.summary: Ask for a grouping draft. Idempotent per input snapshot; runs in the background.
Turn a proposal into editable themes. Explicit; never automatic.
Reject a proposal (kept for the record, hidden from the studio).

get.summary: Everyone's entries, revealed as a batch after collection closes. Anonymous; randomised order.

post.summary: Save a thought. Only while collection is open; only visible to you until it closes.

get.summary: Your own entries for this sprint, on any device.

delete.summary: Delete one of your entries while collection is open.

patch.summary: Edit one of your entries while collection is open.

get.summary:
Live hints for a sprint. Authorization is re-checked periodically; a
revoked member's stream ends within one heartbeat.
Experiments for this sprint.

post.summary: Propose an experiment. The nominated owner must accept before it counts.

get.summary: Experiments carried from earlier sprints ("Last time, we said…").

patch.summary: Edit an experiment or record its outcome. Facilitators of the sprint and the owner may edit.

post.summary: The nominated owner accepts (or declines) ownership.

get.summary: CSV export. Summary: one row per theme. Raw: one row per entry.
Markdown export.

patch.summary: Personal reminder preference for this sprint.

get.summary: The stage as the caller may see it. Same shape for participants, facilitator and presenter.

post.summary: Your own attendance and readiness.
Facilitator: mark someone present or absent.
Facilitator commands. Applied only if `expected_version` matches the stage.
Add anonymous context to a theme during the meeting. Released in batches by the facilitator.
Controller heartbeat. Keeps the "who controls the stage" indicator honest.

put.summary: Facilitator's discussion notes for a theme.

post.summary: Pass your turn (only meaningful when the card shows you).
Add a workspace member to the sprint.

delete.summary: Remove a participant. Sealed entries they already saved stay in the sprint pool.

get.summary: The meeting recap. Participants see it once published; the facilitator always.

put.summary: Save, regenerate, or publish the recap. Publishing is explicit.

get.summary: Themes, their entries, and the ungrouped pool. Available once collection has closed.

post.summary: Create a theme, optionally with entries.
Reorder themes. Not structural: does not reset voting.
Move entries back to the ungrouped pool.

delete.summary: Delete a theme; its entries return to the ungrouped pool.

patch.summary: Edit a theme's text and flags. Text edits don't reset voting; entry changes do.

post.summary: Merge this theme into another. Text of the target is kept; entries move.
Split entries out of a theme into a new one.
Move the sprint through its lifecycle. Every transition is checked server-side.

get.summary: Voting state for the caller: open round with private remaining budget, closed rounds with totals.

post.summary: Cast or withdraw a vote. At most one per theme; budget enforced transactionally.
Open a voting round over the current theme set. Freezes grouping until closed or cancelled.
Close (reveal totals) or cancel the open round.
Create a workspace. The creator becomes its owner.

get.summary: Workspace details: settings, members, pending invitations.
Recent facilitator/owner actions. Contains resource ids, never content.
Workspace-wide experiment history.

post.summary: Invite a teammate by email. Sends a link; joining requires verifying that address.

delete.summary: Remove a member. Their sessions keep working elsewhere but every request to this workspace fails from now on.

patch.summary: Promote or demote a member (owner only).

get.summary: Sprints in a workspace, newest first.

post.summary: Create a sprint (owners and members can create; the creator or the chosen facilitator runs it).

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up.
Readiness: the database answers.

available.description: A provider is configured on this server.

enabled.description: This sprint opted in before collection started.

mode.description: "replace" clears existing themes first; "add" appends the draft's themes.

ready.description: true = "Ready to speak", false = "Pass for now".
Only shown to the facilitator and to the person themself.

collecting.description: Sprints currently collecting that the caller participates in, most recently opened first.

upcoming.description: Sprints the caller participates in that are past collection but not finished (retro soon or live).

cast.description: true to add a vote, false to take it back.

oneOf.description: A short silent-reading pause before a difficult theme. Ends with the timer; skippable via TimerClear.

expected_version.description: The stage version the client last saw. Mismatch → 409, refetch.

opening_question.description: Optional brief opening question for the retro's first minutes.

category.description: Optional. A thought without a category is "unsorted" and can be sorted later.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key so retries after a dropped connection don't duplicate.

override_limit.description: Required to create more than three experiments in one sprint.

workspace_name.description: Only present when the caller's verified email matches the invitation.

sprint_id.description: Add the invitee to this sprint once they join.

budget.description: Votes per person; defaults to the sprint setting.

rephrasings.description: Optional neutral rephrasings keyed by entry id. Never replace originals.

body.description: Replace the recap text. Omit to regenerate a draft from the meeting record.

reason.description: Shown when the order departs from vote totals.

sent.description: Always true when the request was accepted; existence of an account is never revealed.

SharedEntry.description: The shared, anonymous representation. Add fields here with care.

entry_count.description: Aggregate only, and only once collection has closed.

retro_date.description: Local calendar date of the retro in `timezone`.

has_unreleased_context.description: Facilitator only: there is context waiting to be released.

quiet_reading.description: A short silent-reading pause is running: the stage stays quiet.

reset_voting_reason.description: Required when the change alters the theme set while a vote round is open.

context.description: Released anonymous context added during the meeting.

entry_count.description: Number of entries — entries, not people.

votes.description: Vote total from the most recent closed round, if any.

confirm.description: Required for closing collection (it reveals feedback) and reopening it.

ai_processing.description: Only honoured while the sprint is a draft (privacy choices lock at collection start).

display_name.description: Used only when this email has no account yet.

eligible.description: True when you are eligible to vote (a participant; facilitators vote too).

my_votes.description: Your own choices in this round. Private.

totals.description: Totals per theme, only after the round has closed.
